entities.summary: Henryk Tomasz Pytel was a Polish ice hockey player. He played for the Poland national team at the 1976 Winter Olympics in Innsbruck, the 1980 Winter Olympics in Lake Placid, and the 1984 Winter Olympics in Sarajevo.
